claim: After the split, evo still depends on files in the old, still-changing repository that the snapshot does not capture. (1) The corrected physio reruns (al_v2/physio_fix/*) are the only valid data for I-001, e02 and the future L1 calibration, but they are not in snapshot/MANIFEST.json. They live in the old repository, which keeps running. physio_fix also holds two folders per case (p062 with no results, p062_gpu2 with results), and nothing records which one counts. (2) The FEBio binary and the MKL library, which produce every reference number in gates 1-4, are taken from the old repository's working tree (config.json). No version or hash of them is recorded (F-0014 (6)), so a rebuild there silently changes the reference. (3) results/method/ in the new repository holds 76 invalid pre-fix fl_*.json files whose names carry no invalid mark; only a separate INVALID.md says so. A glob over fl_*.json mixes invalid data into any new analysis.
evidence: snapshot/MANIFEST.json: grep 'physio_fix' -> 0 matches (frame_c3c4.json is present, line 52); Glob 'biocage stimulation test 1'/human_study/al_v2/physio_fix/** (p062/ has case.feb, preflight.json only; p062_gpu2/ has case.xplt, summary.json); config.json:3-4 (febio_bin, mkl_lib in the old repository); results/method/ (79 entries, fl_*.json) and results/method/INVALID.md:3.
how_to_reproduce: grep physio_fix snapshot/MANIFEST.json; ls results/method; read config.json.

fix_options.option: Snapshot the physio_fix result folders actually used (summary.json, xplt hash, case.feb hash) into the manifest, and record which folder per case is authoritative
Record sha256 of febio4 and the MKL libraries in config.json and in every gate report; warn when they change
Move invalid fl_*.json into results/method/INVALID_prefix/ (or rename *_INVALID.json) so globs cannot pick them up

summary_zh: 專案拆分之後，新專案仍然依賴舊專案中的檔案，而快照沒有把它們收進來。（一）負荷曲線修正後重跑的生理負荷結果，是目前唯一有效、可用來驗證 I-001 和校正快速模型的資料，但它們只放在舊專案，舊專案還在持續變動，快照清單裡沒有它們；而且每個設計各有兩個資料夾，沒有註明哪一個才是正式的。（二）所有驗證關卡的參考數字都來自 FEBio 程式，但這個程式和數學函式庫放在舊專案裡，沒有記錄版本或雜湊值，舊專案一旦重新編譯，參考答案就會在沒人察覺的情況下改變。（三）新專案的結果資料夾裡有 76 個已知無效的舊結果檔，檔名上沒有標示無效；程式若一次讀取全部檔案，就會把無效資料混進去。
